description: Find out why a TypeScript project is slow. Runs one traced type check of the project (plus `runs` untraced timing runs) and returns compact JSON: Check time, file count, compiler error summary (not the full list of errors), `diagnoses` (a known slow-type pattern with location, evidence and a fix), the top 5 measured findings, and warnings. It takes as long as a full type check of the project (seconds to minutes), plus the extra timing runs.

maxOldSpaceMb.description: Heap limit in MB for the compiler process. Ignored with TypeScript 7.

project.description: Absolute path to a directory with a tsconfig.json, or to a tsconfig file.

runs.description: Untraced timing runs for a stable Check time (default 1). Each run is one more full type check. Use 3 or more for a median.

timeoutSeconds.description: Compiler timeout in seconds for each type check. Default 900.

typescript.description: Path to a typescript package directory to use instead of the one in the project (5.x, 6.x or 7.x).

name: analyze
